truePath.heading: Prepare for the Cassiopeia mission
truePath.intro: Directive 8020 combines branching conversations with real-time danger. Plan for both the choices you make and the way you move through the environment.

steps.title: Meet the crew
steps.sub: Start with the confirmed character names and roles. Young is the pilot portrayed by Lashana Lynch; Eisele is the senior mission officer.

steps.title: Watch your surroundings
steps.sub: The alien can imitate people. Stealth, reflexes and improvised weapons matter alongside dialogue decisions.

steps.title: Explore another branch
steps.sub: Turning Points let you revisit key decisions. Consult the options available in your current game mode rather than assuming every choice is permanent.

faqs.q: What kind of game is Directive 8020?
faqs.a: It is a cinematic science-fiction horror adventure from Supermassive Games. The crew of the Cassiopeia faces an alien capable of mimicking people, and your decisions shape the story.
Lashana Lynch portrays Brianna Young, a pilot aboard the Cassiopeia.
The official description of Turning Points confirms that players can return to key decisions to explore different outcomes. This does not establish a guaranteed route to any particular ending.

faqs.q: Does the game support cooperative play?
faqs.a: Movie Night supports local group play. The current Steam listing also advertises online co-op, and the PlayStation listing advertises online players. Check the latest listing and requirements for your platform.
